metadata.transition_rules: Hard cuts throughout (2 vocabulary items max: hard cut for escalation/landing pace, restrained cross-dissolve reserved for the three Niagara clips in the reveal beat to soften the slow-down).
metadata.aspect_ratio_rules: 16:9 full-frame for escalation (fast cuts, no letterbox). 2.35:1 letterbox activates only for the reveal beat (Niagara + fort sequence) and the landing beat's campfire/bridge hero shots.
metadata.title_card_rules: Two cards only: opening 'APRIL — MAY 2026' and closing 'HOME.' — minimal typography, high contrast, no invented place names on unverified locations.
metadata.support_insert_rules: No generated inserts. 100% source-led per delivery_promise.source_required=true.
metadata.content_reality_note: Per user-approved direction: 'life on the road' balance — daily-life rhythm (gym/cooking/DIY/driving/office) carries the escalation beat; landmark highlights (Niagara Falls, historic-reenactor field, campfire, bridge) reserved for reveal/landing beats as the emotional payoff.
